Hi {name},

You can now log in to ClubAdmin yourself. Your memberships, groups and history stay as they are.

Log in or create your login with this email address:
{url}

The link is valid until {expires}.

adult.intro: You have reached the adult age. You decide which of your guardians keep access to your account and your data in ClubAdmin.
adult.keepMeans: Keep access: they continue to see and do what they could before.
